68:43.text: Their eyes will be cast down and ignominy will cover them; they used to be called to prostrate themselves
, while they were healthy and good
(in the life of the world, but they did not)

68:44.text: Then leave Me Alone with such as belie this Qur’ân. We shall punish them gradually from directions they perceive not.

68:45.text: And I will grant them a respite. Verily, My Plan is strong.

68:46.text: ask them a wage, so that they are heavily burdened with debt?

68:47.text: (the Unseen - here in this Verse it means Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz)
is in their hands, so that they can write it down?

68:48.text: So wait with patience for the Decision of your Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish - when he cried out
while he was in deep sorrow.

68:49.text: Had not a Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been
(left in the stomach of the fish, but We forgave him)
: so he was cast off on the naked shore, while he was to be blamed.

68:50.text: Then his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

68:51.text: And verily, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes

68:52.text: But it is nothing else than a Reminder to all the ‘Âlamîn

69:3.text: And what will make you know what the Inevitable is?

69:4.text: Thamûd and ‘Âd people denied the Qâri‘ah

69:5.text: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by the awful cry!

69:6.text: And as for ‘Âd, they were destroyed by a furious violent wind!

69:7.text: Which Allâh imposed on them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so that you could see men lying overthrown
, as if they were hollow trunks of date-palms!

69:8.text: Do you see any remnants of them?
